basic_details.job_title: UNOM Guest Lecturer Recruitment 2026 - Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Madras University (UNOM) Guest Lecturer Recruitment 2026 Notification has been released on 29 July 2026 on the official website of UNOM. A total of 4 vacancies have been announced through the UNOM Guest Lecturer Recruitment 2026.

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for UNOM Guest Lecturer Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: .
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 05-08-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the UNOM Guest Lecturer recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the UNOM Guest Lecturer positions is 05-08-2026. Candidates are strongly advised to submit their applications well in advance of this deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Guest Lecturer post?
faq.answer: To be eligible for the Guest Lecturer position at Madras University, candidates must possess a Ph.D degree in Geology or Applied Geology. This is the primary educational requirement for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Guest Lecturer post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies announced for the Guest Lecturer (Full-time) positions at Madras University. This offers a limited but significant opportunity for qualified individuals.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Guest Lecturer position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Guest Lecturer post will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 30,000/- per month. This is a fixed monthly remuneration for the contract period.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the UNOM Guest Lecturer recruitment is strictly offline. Candidates need to download the application form, fill it out, and submit it via post or as specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Guest Lecturer role?
faq.answer: The selection process will be based on UGC norms, which include evaluating marks for educational qualifications, teaching experience, publications, rank, and performance in the interview. A roaster system will also be followed.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for the UNOM Guest Lecturer recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the UNOM Guest Lecturer recruitment. Candidates can apply without incurring any application charges.

faq.question: Q8. Where is Madras University located?
faq.answer: Madras University (UNOM) is located in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, with the pincode 600025. The recruitment is for positions within this university campus.

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this Guest Lecturer recruitment at Madras University is 493/2026-27/GL/Appl.Geol./UNOM. This number should be referenced in all application-related correspondence.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates apply through online mode?
faq.answer: No, the application mode for this recruitment is exclusively offline. Candidates must download the application form and submit it physically as per the instructions provided in the official notification.
